title: Bellandur ↔ Marathahalli corridor registry
geometryPolicy: Point anchors only. This registry intentionally contains no building footprints, parcel boundaries, road centerlines, or exact building geometry.

coverage.corridorDescription: ORR / Sarjapur Outer Ring Road mobility slice from Bellandur through Devarabeesanahalli and Kadubeesanahalli to Marathahalli.
coverage.contextNote: Bagmane Tech Park and the Mahadevapura/Hoodi cluster are retained as adjacent employment-demand context for the next corridor phase; they are not asserted to be inside this bounded slice.

stops.name: Bellanduru
stops.note: OSM place=suburb point used as the southern area anchor; it is not a junction survey point.

stops.name: Bellandur Central
stops.note: One platform of the OSM Bellandur Central pair; use as a named transit anchor, not a stop-line location.

stops.name: Ecospace
stops.note: OSM named bus-stop platform; paired opposite-direction platform is a separate OSM node.

stops.name: Devarabeesanahalli
stops.note: OSM BMTC platform on the ORR corridor; coordinate is a stop anchor rather than a junction centroid.

stops.name: Kadubeesanahalli Underpass
stops.note: OSM junction=yes named node; no lane count, turn geometry, or elevation is inferred here.

stops.name: Marathahalli Market
stops.note: One OSM BMTC platform in the Marathahalli Market pair; retain both platforms if later modeling dwell or curb access.

stops.name: Marathahalli Bridge
stops.note: OSM named BMTC platform used as the northern terminus anchor; bridge deck geometry remains out of scope.

attractors.name: RMZ Ecoworld
attractors.anchorBasis: Derived from the center of an OSM way named RMZ Ecoworld Internal Road; not a campus centroid.
attractors.note: RMZ's public project page identifies the campus as a large IT park in Bellandur on Outer Ring Road; this registry keeps only a coarse point anchor.

attractors.name: Embassy TechVillage
attractors.anchorBasis: Derived from the center of the OSM commercial way named Embassy TechVillage.
attractors.note: Embassy Office Parks publicly lists the campus on Outer Ring Road near New Horizon College in Devarabeesanahalli/Kadubeesanahalli.

attractors.name: Ecospace
attractors.anchorBasis: Derived from the center of the OSM commercial way named RMZ Ecospace.
attractors.note: Brookfield Properties publicly describes Ecospace as an office campus on Sarjapura Main Road in Bellandur and provides its campus-scale attributes; no footprint is copied.

attractors.name: Cessna Business Park
attractors.anchorBasis: Derived from the center of the OSM commercial way named Cessna Business Park.
attractors.note: The public CSEZ record identifies Cessna SEZ as an IT/ITES development in Kadubeesanahalli; the registry does not infer its internal buildings.

attractors.name: Prestige Tech Park
attractors.anchorBasis: Derived from the center of the OSM commercial way named Prestige Tech Park.
attractors.note: OSM provides the named commercial feature and anchor. The technology-employment classification is retained for the requested attractor registry but should be checked against an operator or public-estate source before calibration.

attractors.name: Salarpuria Softzone
attractors.anchorBasis: Derived from the center of the OSM way named Salarpuria Softzone.
attractors.note: OSM provides the named commercial feature and anchor. No exact building mass, tenant count, or employment total is asserted.

attractors.name: Bagmane Tech Park
attractors.anchorBasis: Derived from the center of the OSM relation named Bagmane Tech Park.
attractors.note: Bagmane publicly describes this as a completed Grade A business park in C.V. Raman Nagar. It is an adjacent feeder-demand context point, not part of the Bellandur–Marathahalli boundary.

attractors.name: Mahadevapura technology/employment cluster
attractors.anchorBasis: OSM named Mahadevapura relation used as a coarse cluster anchor.
attractors.note: This is a place/cluster anchor for future demand modeling, not a claim that every employer in Mahadevapura is represented.

attractors.name: Hoodi technology/employment cluster
attractors.anchorBasis: OSM named Hoodi relation used as a coarse cluster anchor.
attractors.note: This is a place/cluster anchor for future demand modeling, not a claim that every employer in Hoodi is represented.

osm_overpass_2026_09_15.name: OpenStreetMap via Overpass API
osm_overpass_2026_09_15.processing: Queried the corridor names in bbox 12.90,77.64,13.00,77.75 and the adjacent-context names in bbox 12.93,77.67,13.02,77.75; retained only the object IDs listed beside each registry record.
osm_overpass_2026_09_15.transformation: Node coordinates are retained as source points. Way/relation centers returned by Overpass are stored as DERIVED approximate point anchors; no OSM geometry is copied into this registry.

rmz_ecoworld_official.name: RMZ Ecoworld project page
rmz_ecoworld_official.license: Public company webpage; no separate open-data license asserted. Only the public place name and location description are used; no page assets are copied.

rmz_ecoworld_official.transformation: Used only to corroborate the attractor role and locality; coordinates remain from the OSM anchor.
